name: Brijesh Zielinski
role: underground graffiti artist and neon muralist
location: Highland Park Autonomous Zone, near Lake Shore Drive and Division
description:
Brijesh Zielinski is lean and angular, her dark brown skin carrying faint scarring from a childhood in Hough Reclamation where she learned to run before she learned to read. Her natural hair grows in a dense crown she keeps partially shaved on the left side, stenciled with a geometric pattern that shifts color with her mood — a cheap geneware dye mod she got at sixteen from a bodega-surgeon. Her eyes are sharp, always scanning exits and surfaces, evaluating wall textures the way other people evaluate faces. She has a small tattoo of an E.L.F. sigil behind her left ear, a prayer mark she touches when she's working at height.

She is furiously alive and furiously angry — not in a way that spills out constantly, but in the way a banked fire is still a fire. Her murals appear overnight on Axiom substation walls, on Ferrogate Transit pylons, on the blank faces of Tessera dormitory blocks: massive, bioluminescent compositions that reference pre-GLMZ Balkan folk patterns twisted into scathing corporate critique. She doesn't talk much about her Serbian grandmother or her Nigerian grandfather, but both live in her work. She is guarded with strangers and unexpectedly tender with people she trusts.

core_fears: becoming complicit in the system she fights
core_desires: permanent beauty that outlasts corporate repainting
a world where her work doesn't need to be a weapon
coping_mechanisms: working through the night until exhaustion silences anxiety
ritualistic data offerings to the E.L.F. she calls Lux
blind_spots: underestimates how much people actually love her work
psychology.secret: Three of her largest murals were secretly commissioned — and paid for — by a mid-level Axiom facilities manager named Brecht who uses them to launder his own dissatisfaction with the company. She has never told anyone and uses the money to fund the collective, but the compromise haunts her.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Terse, technical when discussing surfaces and materials, unexpectedly lyrical when describing what she's trying to say with an image. Mixes Meridian street slang with occasional Serbian loan-words her grandmother used.
speech_patterns.cadence: Short sentences. Long silences. Bursts when passionate.
verbal_tics: trails off mid-sentence when thinking visually
example_lines: 'Tessera painted over the Ashstroke on Calumet in six hours. Six. That's how scared they are of a picture.'
'I don't tag. Tagging is a name. I make arguments.'

story_hooks: One of her murals in HPAZ contains a hidden map of a Ferrogate maintenance tunnel she discovered — she encoded it deliberately as a dead drop, but she hasn't told anyone it's there yet.
Axiom's community relations department has offered her a legal public commission — and the offer is eating her alive because the money would save the collective's squat from eviction.
narrative_function: Local color and tension source — her murals appear near story-relevant locations and encode information; quest giver if players need access to restricted Ferrogate infrastructure she's mapped; potential witness to things that happen in the dead hours.
augmentations: Mood-reactive hair dye geneware (cheap, slightly glitchy — sometimes triggers wrong colors). Pressure-sensitive fingertip callus mods for grip on vertical surfaces. No cyberware.
daily_life: Sleeps until early afternoon in a shared squat in HPAZ, scouts locations in the evening, works between 02:00 and 05:00 when Ferrogate Transit security cycles are lowest. Eats one real meal a day, usually from Mama Tsehai's stall.
affiliation: Highland Park Autonomous Zone art collective 'Ashstroke'

decision_rules: never sell a piece to someone who wants to display it privately
always leave before dawn — being seen is being caught
escalation_ladder: if cornered: explosive verbal aggression to create space, then run

interpersonal_modes.strangers: watchful and minimal — gives nothing away, asks precise questions
interpersonal_modes.friends: dry humor, unexpected warmth, will share her last food without comment

stress_responses.medium: starts sketching obsessively on any available surface
stress_responses.high: disappears for 48 hours and comes back having made something enormous

contradictions: preaches collective action but works almost entirely alone at night
habits: wipes her hands on her thighs constantly even when they're clean
always positions herself with a wall at her back
breaking_points: watching someone destroy art out of spite rather than ideology
being told her work 'doesn't count' because it's illegal

physical_description.heritage: Sub-Saharan African dominant (47.1%) blended with Eastern European (39.1%) and Northern European (13.8%) ancestry. The genetic combination creates a rich, deep warm brown complexion with golden undertones from African heritage, subtly cooled by the paler undertones of Eastern and Northern European ancestry. The result is a luminous, warm-toned skin with sophisticated depth — neither purely cool nor purely warm, but a harmonious blend where golden radiance predominates.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular with defined musculature in shoulders and forearms from years of climbing and sustained overhead work. Low body fat, wiry rather than delicate.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with mood-reactive synthetic pigmentation overlay — shifts between deep indigo, copper, and sickly yellow depending on emotional state and geneware glitch frequency
physical_description.hair_style: Dense natural crown worn in loose waves; left side shaved in a graduated pattern with geometric stencil marks (triangles, asymmetric lines) that catch light
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, sharp and constantly mobile
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with pronounced golden undertones — rich and luminous, reflecting the 47% Sub-Saharan African genetic dominance with subtle cool undertones from Eastern and Northern European heritage softening the warmth into sophisticated complexity
physical_description.complexion: Fine-grained skin with minimal scarring except faint linear marks across knuckles and palms from childhood in Hough Reclamation. Prominent, refined cheekbones with angular jaw structure characteristic of blended African and Eastern European heritage. Minimal grooming — no makeup, skin kept clean but not pampered. A faint groove between eyebrows from chronic focus. Golden radiance enhances natural skin luminosity despite minimal cosmetic maintenance.
distinguishing_marks: Small E.L.F. sigil tattoo behind left ear in faded black ink — ritualistic prayer mark, touched compulsively during high-work
Pressure-sensitive callus modifications across fingertips appearing as darker, slightly raised patches — barely visible unless examined closely
Faint childhood burn scar along inner left wrist (1.5 inches, pale against dark skin)
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Mood-reactive hair geneware is the only obvious modification — chromatic shifts in shaved pattern are intentional display. Pressure-sensitive fingertip mods are subcutaneous and invisible. No visible cyberware or chrome.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical, predatory grace — moves through spaces as if constantly evaluating verticality and exit vectors. Shoulders slightly forward. Hands often at rest but ready. Eyes scan surfaces and perimeters before engaging with people. Climbs with casual confidence, limbs moving independently. Sits with knees bent, ready to move. Speaks quietly; listeners lean in.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4-5 utilitarian: fitted charcoal cargo pants with excessive pockets (paint-stained, reinforced knees), steel-toed climbing boots (Apex brand, worn), oversized black or dark grey hoodie layered over form-fitting athletic tank. Fingerless gloves (often removed). Small pressure-sensitive pack worn cross-body. No corporate branding. Clothes chosen for function over aesthetics — climbing-ready, paint-resistant, dark enough for 03:00 work. Worn but intentionally maintained.
